questions.question: What happened to the northern kingdom of Israel in this chapter?
options: It prospered greatly and grew strong once again
It was conquered by Assyria and the people exiled
It made a lasting peace with the empire of Assyria
It split once more into two rival kingdoms
questions.answer: It was conquered by Assyria and the people exiled

questions.question: Why did Israel fall, according to the writer?
options: Misfortune and very bad luck overtook them
They sinned against the LORD and worshiped other gods
Their armies were far too weak to resist the enemy
A long and severe famine drained all their strength
questions.answer: They sinned against the LORD and worshiped other gods

questions.question: The capital Samaria fell to the king of Assyria.
The king of _____ captured Samaria and carried Israel away into exile.
Israel fell because they had _____ against the LORD their God.
